entries.265809518ca9adf5: This is a single-segment business that uses iron scrap as the main raw material, melts steel in electric furnaces, and manufactures and sells steel materials such as bar steel, wire rod, and shaped steel, as well as processed products for civil engineering and construction. Production is based at its Nagaoka, Sanjo, Kumoide, Mitsuke, and Kitakata plants; consolidated subsidiary Cortex Co., Ltd. processes and sells the products, and Metal Transport Co., Ltd. handles transport. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,598 million, and its main customers are ITOCHU Marubeni Sumitomo Techno-Steel Corporation and Hanwa Co., Ltd. Overseas sales are less than 10% of revenue.

entries.797ea477f492189d: Under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2027, formulated in June 2025 (three years from fiscal 2025 through fiscal 2027), the company aims to strengthen its materials business by enhancing collaboration with business partners, developing new customers and improving cost competitiveness through operational improvements; to expand its processed products business by increasing sales of products for precast plants, capturing demand for infrastructure maintenance and national resilience, and expanding staffing at its Tokyo Processed Products Sales Office; and to control fixed costs and promote information technology. It states that, within an integrated structure running from steel materials to processed products for civil engineering and construction, it will differentiate itself from other companies by developing and expanding high value-added products.
